name: deck-doc-to-deck
description: Turns a PRD, PR-FAQ, strategy doc or report into a presented deck in Claude Slides, with a slide plan drawn from the doc, a keep-in-the-doc list and a check that the deck says what the doc says. Use for "run deck-doc-to-deck", "turn this PRD into slides", "doc to deck", "make a deck from this doc", "the room still wants slides", "slides from our PR-FAQ", "present this strategy doc", "check the deck matches the doc", part of the Claude Slides for Product Managers Pack by 90n.
